provenance.sourcePrompt:
Three-column time-echo split effect over backgroundVideo. Canvas-based rendering (no multiple video playback) to prevent black frames. THREE split events in this 30s clip at fixed times
═══ HTML STRUCTURE ═══
#mainVideo: backgroundVideo element, plays normally, position:absolute, width:100%, height:100%, object-fit:cover, z-index:1
#auxVideo1: same src as backgroundVideo, muted, preload:auto, DO NOT call .play(), position:fixed, left:-9999px, width:1px, height:1px. Used only for currentTime seek
#auxVideo2: identical to #auxVideo1
#splitCanvas: position:absolute, top:0, left:0, width:100%, height:100%, z-index:2, display:none initially
#detectCanvas: position:fixed, left:-9999px, width:64px, height:36px. Hidden. Used for scene-cut luminance detection
#barLeft: position:absolute, z-index:3, left:calc(33.33% - 5px), top:0, width:10px, height:100%, background:#000, box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)
#barRight: position:absolute, z-index:3, left:calc(66.67% - 5px), top:0, width:10px, height:100%, background:#000, box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)
#splitWrapper: wraps #splitCanvas + #barLeft + #barRight. position:absolute, top:0, left:0, width:100%, height:100%, opacity:0, visibility:hidden, z-index:2
═══ SPLIT ENTER — trigger at t=3.0s, t=12.0s, t=22.0s ═══
1. Set #splitWrapper visibility:visible, then animate opacity 0→1 over 0.15s easeOut (CSS transition)
2. Animate #barLeft: transform translateX(-100%)→translateX(0), 0.15s easeOut
3. Animate #barRight: transform translateX(+100%)→translateX(0), 0.15s easeOut
4. Set #splitCanvas display:block
5. Fade #mainVideo opacity 1→0 over 0.15s
6. Start canvas rAF loop (see below)
7. Record holdStartTime = performance.now()
═══ CANVAS rAF LOOP (while split active) ═══
const ctx = splitCanvas.getContext('2d')
Resize splitCanvas.width/height to match container pixel dimensions each frame if needed
const W = splitCanvas.width, H = splitCanvas.height
// Seek aux videos (no play call)
auxVideo1.currentTime = Math.min(mainVideo.currentTime + 0.3, mainVideo.duration - 0.01)
auxVideo2.currentTime = Math.min(mainVideo.currentTime + 0.6, mainVideo.duration - 0.01)
// Draw three columns — each column shows full-width video cropped to its third
ctx.drawImage(mainVideo,  0,       0, W, H,   0,       0, W/3, H);  // left col: crop left third of frame
ctx.drawImage(auxVideo1,  W/3,     0, W/3, H, W/3,     0, W/3, H);  // center col: crop center third
ctx.drawImage(auxVideo2,  W*2/3,   0, W/3, H, W*2/3,   0, W/3, H);  // right col: crop right third
// Scene-cut detection on #detectCanvas
const dCtx = detectCanvas.getContext('2d')
dCtx.drawImage(mainVideo, 0, 0, 64, 36)
const pixels = dCtx.getImageData(0, 0, 64, 36).data
let lum = 0
for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) lum += (pixels[i] + pixels[i+1] + pixels[i+2]) / 3
lum /= (pixels.length / 4)
if (typeof prevLum !== 'undefined' && Math.abs(lum - prevLum) > 18) { triggerExit(); return; }
prevLum = lum
// Fallback exit after 4s
if (performance.now() - holdStartTime > 4000) { triggerExit(); return; }
rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
═══ SPLIT EXIT (triggerExit function) ═══
cancelAnimationFrame(rafId)
// Animate #splitWrapper as single unit: opacity 1→0, 0.15s easeIn. ONE transition on parent only
splitWrapper.style.transition = 'opacity 0.15s ease-in'
splitWrapper.style.opacity = '0'
// Simultaneously slide bars out
barLeft.style.transition = 'transform 0.15s ease-in'
barLeft.style.transform = 'translateX(-100%)'
barRight.style.transition = 'transform 0.15s ease-in'
barRight.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)'
// Fade main video back in
mainVideo.style.transition = 'opacity 0.15s ease-in'
mainVideo.style.opacity = '1'
setTimeout(() => {
splitWrapper.style.visibility = 'hidden'
splitCanvas.style.display = 'none'
prevLum = undefined
}, 150)
═══ BETWEEN EVENTS ═══
#splitWrapper: visibility:hidden, opacity:0. #mainVideo: opacity:1, playing. No artifacts
NO text, NO captions, NO labels, NO UI elements of any kind
